newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Securities to brief media on watchdog probe.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Securities to brief media on watchdog probe.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co said it would hold a news conference at 0830 GMT on Thursday on a probe by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission.

Last September, a report carried by a regional Japanese newspaper alleged that Nomura officials were being investigated by the watchdog on suspicion that the company reimbursed huge sums to a Tokyo-based corporate investor to make up for losses incurred through futures trading in Singapore.
Nomura at that time denied that the probe was conducted into the actions of its officials.
